style: Instrumental electronic science fiction strategy game soundtrack in the musical world of Ben Prunty FTL and FTL Multiverse. Dry hollow pulse-synth lead, dusty metallic plucks, elastic resonant bass and slow tape echoes; rusted machinery and lonely distant signals. An evolving melodic instrumental with arpeggiated inner motion, subtle harmonic colour and clear phrasing. Exploration arrangement: spacious, reflective and curious. Soft detailed electronic percussion, a gently moving bass and delicate repeating synthesizer patterns support the expressive lead. The middle passage opens into lighter suspended textures before the developed theme returns. Intimate game underscore with room between phrases. Purely instrumental. Gm, 100 BPM.
